topic: Protein at every meal, simple examples

scenes.text: Only eating protein at dinner? That's a fucking mistake.
Chips for lunch, then one giant fucking pile of chicken at night. Every single day.
Breakfast, eggs or yogurt. Lunch, chicken or fish. Snack, cottage cheese. Dinner, beans or fucking salmon.
Simple, normal food, every single meal. Then get in here and lift heavy as fuck.
Protein at every fucking meal. Keep it that simple.

caption: Only eating protein at dinner? Spread it out: add a protein food to every meal, like eggs or yogurt at breakfast, chicken or fish at lunch, beans or salmon at dinner. Keep it simple and keep lifting. Save this for your next gym day.
